buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK The Item covers the following Services:

OEM service engineer supervision for carrying out the below works in TUG SARTHI. EQUIPMENT: Propulsion Voith System – PORT & STBD MODEL: VSP SEABIRD 21R5, MAKE: Voith Turbo Schneider Propulsion REQUIRED MAN DAYS OF SERVICE ENGINEER AT CSL - 10 DAYS. Payment will be at actuals. THE WORK INVOLVES, 1. Clean, check and repair helm indicator, steering operating switch including rudder angle feedback switch. 2. Inspect the condition of voith blade for any damage and abnormality. 3. Inspect the blade actuating mechanism for proper functioning. 4. Check the axial clearance of blades with rotor casing for correct limits as per user manual. 5. Check The Main Seal For Any Leakage And Good Condition. 6. Drain the hydraulic oil from the elevated tank and system. Flush through the system and clean the tank. Renew the filters (06 in nos) and oil (oil and filter to be supplied by firm) 7. Inspect the Condition of Main Hydraulic Pump. 8. Inspect the bearings and take clearances in voith propulsion system. Ensure that they are fully lub ricated before undocking. 9. Inspect the condition of main gear toothing for any damage. GENERAL NOTES: 1. The work shall be carried out at CSL/ISRF depending on availability of vessel. 2. Inspection of OEM-supplied spares shall be carried out upon intimation from CSL charging enginee r. 3. OEM shall attend Basin & Sea Trials upon intimation from CSL charging engineer. 4. The detailed report to be submitted after completion of works. 5. Copy of OEM authorization letter to be submitted along with the offer. 6. CSL’s standard payment terms, i.e., 100% payment within 45 days after completion of the job/ supply of materials . 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration.
